Typefield for MacPrivate beta

Private beta for Mac.

This beta is distributed without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization. macOS may block Typefield the first time you open it; use the steps below to approve it.

Download beta DMG ↓

Version 0.59.7 beta. Sign in to GitHub with an account invited to the private Typefield repository.

Compatibility

macOS 13 or newer. Apple silicon.

Access

A GitHub account with access to the private Typefield repository is required for the beta download.

License

No Typefield account or license key is required for this beta build.

Install and open.

  1. Sign in to your invited GitHub account, then download the beta from this page.
  2. Open the DMG and move Typefield to Applications.
  3. Try to open Typefield. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway, then confirm Open. Apple’s instructions ↗
